title: Preserve structured DOM decoder rejection
api_or_output: Structured existing INPUT diagnostic instead of internal declaration-validation exception; no new public API

acceptance.description: Preserve decoder terminal diagnostics in synchronous and asynchronous DOM transport when malformed UTF input returns decoded prefix and a rejection together, including final input.

Verify five frozen fuzz reproducers and chunked strict/diagnostic/recovery DOM paths; preserve callback/I/O exception identity, valid encoding/declaration behavior, bounded scratch and documented owned allocation boundaries.
Record actual source and API/check evidence against verified dependencies and integrate the bounded repair before the M3 gate.

handoff.summary: Created for corpus fuzz failure PHKvPg==: decoder rejected before DomSink.ValidateAbsentDeclaration.
